members.name: parameterName

members.name: sqlType

members.name: direction
members.description: Table-valued parameters are emitted as input.

members.name: rows
members.description: Absent (a null parameter Value) when the source is null; for the model-based, keyed-model, and virtual-compound-key overloads, also absent whenever the source yields zero rows, since those overloads materialize rows into a List<SqlDataRecord> before assignment. The raw SqlDataRecord overload instead nulls the Value only when the source is an ICollection<SqlDataRecord>/IReadOnlyCollection<SqlDataRecord> whose Count is zero; any other (lazy) sequence is passed through unenumerated, so a lazily-produced empty sequence still reaches the driver as a non-null, zero-record enumeration. Never System.DBNull.Value; both DBNull and an empty SqlDataRecord enumeration are rejected by Microsoft.Data.SqlClient client-side.

members.name: columns
members.description: Column names and SQL types used by keyed-model and virtual compound-key overloads.

representations.csharp: SqlParameter(SqlDbType.Structured) whose Value is the supplied SqlDataRecord rows or a list constructed in the source iteration order, or a null reference when there are no rows (model-based/keyed/virtual-key overloads only; the raw overload nulls only a null or countable-empty source).
